name: single arm scapula push up
description: A small push-up movement with one arm that moves only the shoulder blades. It builds control of the serratus anterior.
instructions: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
